title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
synopsis:
Kogarashi Fuyuzora is a "hands on" psychic. Ever since the day he got possessed by an evil ghost, he has been burdened with debt. Needing a cheap room to rent, he winds up at a haunted hot springs inn, Yuragi Inn, where only incredibly beautiful girls reside. Amongst the residents is a ghost, Yuuna, who cannot move on to the spirit world. Despite the resistance from the current tenants that are all girls, Kogarashi manages to start his new life at Yuragi Inn.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Yuragi Inn's Yuuna
episodes.synopsis: Kogarashi Fuyuzora is a hands-on psychic, who has finally found a decent place to live and work. Being a psychic, he was supposed to easily exorcise whatever ghost was haunting his new home, but he runs into a minor problem...

episodes.title: Yuuna and the Hot Spring Ping Pong
episodes.synopsis: In accoradance to the Yuragi Inn boarding house rules, Kogarashi finds himself playing a one-game match of ping pong with a certain team?

episodes.title: Yuuna Goes to School
episodes.synopsis: It's Kogarashi's first day of school! Of course, Yuuna decides to tag along, and gets Kogarashi into all sorts of trouble.

episodes.title: Watching Youkai! Sagiri and Yaya are Cautious.
episodes.synopsis: Kogarashi learns more about Sagiri, and she evens hires him for a job! Wait, is this a date? Yaya also starts following Kogarashi around for some reason…

episodes.title: Yuuna's Body Measurements / Nonko's Crunch Time
episodes.synopsis: Yuuna might have found a new friend! Meanwhile, Nonko-sensei needs a lot of help from Kogarashi.

episodes.title: Ms. Nakai's Secret Adventure / A Sweet Day Off with Yuuna
episodes.synopsis: There's a certain secret that Ms. Nakai can't tell the tenants at Yuragi Inn, but she still goes on that adventure. Meanwhile, Kogarashi tries to figure out what Yuuna's lingering regrets can be…

episodes.title: Yuuna's Mysterious Disappearance
episodes.synopsis: Yuuna and Koyuzu are running an errand when a young man they’ve never seen before suddenly calls out. His name is Genshiro Ryuuga, though he’s called the Black Dragon God, and he’s come to Yukemuri Town to find a bride.

episodes.title: Oboro Stops at Nothing
episodes.synopsis: Kogarashi, Sagiri, and Koyuzu carry out their mission to try and rescue Yuuna. However, Oboro, the Black Dragon God's attendant is a formidable enemy.

episodes.title: Chisaki of the Yuragi Inn
episodes.synopsis: Chisaki comes to visit the Yuragi Inn on the weekend. She decides to spend the night and have a sleepover, much to Yuuna and Chisaki's delight.

episodes.title: The Overly Aggressive Sagiri / The Seaside School and Kogarashi
episodes.synopsis: Yuuna tags along to Kogarashi, Sagiri, and Chisaki's seaside school trip. However, through the suggestion of another Chuuma ninja member, Urara, Sagiri needs to buy a new swimsuit.

episodes.title: Dancing Cheek to Cheek with Yuuna / Sagiri and the Final Exam
episodes.synopsis: The sea side school trip continues as Kogarashi faces a monster that was accidentally summoned.

episodes.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs, and…
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is enjoying their last few days of summer vacation. Kogarashi and Yuuna find themselves in Okinawa, and encounter another bound ghost.
